standardValue.description: Sales chance in early stage. Details missing to quantify and schedule. Use this Stage in Pre-Selling Phase to indicate Potential Business
standardValue.label: Sales Chance (New)

standardValue.description: Opportunity is in qualification and/or analysis, Price Information and/or Quote in preparation. No quotation is sent to the customer yet
standardValue.label: Acquisition (Sell)

standardValue.description: Price Information and/or Quote is approved within ETAS, sent to Customer and in negotiation. No business award from customer yet
standardValue.label: Quotation (Quoted)

standardValue.description: Business is secure. Sales Order from Customer not yet received. Sales Order not yet entered in SAP
standardValue.label: Accepted

standardValue.description: Project is lost. Reason must be provided
standardValue.label: Lost

standardValue.description: Project is cancelled by customer e.g. due to missing budget
standardValue.label: Project Cancelled

standardValue.description: Use in case of mistaken Opportunity Creation
standardValue.label: Invalid Data
